snippet.title: Midnight Moments Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4666090/Midnight_Moments 

Build rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, and quiet neighbourhood corners in a small, wholesome cyberpunk diorama game. Place handcrafted props and citizens, and create a corner of a city that feels truly lived-in. No goals. No pressure. Just vibes.

Midnight Moments is coming to PC on Steam, wishlist and follow now to stay updated.
